title: 5 Ways You’re Making Life Harder Than It Needs to Be
paragraphs: 5 Ways You’re Making Life Harder Than It Needs to Be
You’re just carrying things God never asked you to carry.
Here’s the truth most people won’t say out loud:
Some of your struggles… are self-inflicted.
But because you’re holding on to the wrong things.
Every outcome. Every person. Every detail.
But control is a burden you were never built to carry.
Scripture says, “Be still, and know that I am God.” (Psalm 46:10)
2. You keep revisiting what God already forgave.
But you keep reopening the wound.
Listen—when Jesus said, “It is finished” (John 19:30), He meant your sin too.
Stop punishing yourself for what Christ already paid for.
3. You’re chasing approval from people who didn’t call you.
But Galatians 1:10 cuts deep: “Am I now trying to win the approval of human beings, or of God?”
4. You’re feeding your flesh and starving your spirit.
Man doesn’t live on bread alone—but on every word from God (Matthew 4:4).
You’re hungry because you’re eating the wrong things.
You know what God told you.
But you’re waiting for the “perfect time.”
Clarity doesn’t always come before obedience.
Sometimes it comes after you move.
Grace is still on the table.
Not when you get it all together.
Jesus didn’t come to make your life complicated.
He came to set you free.
From burden to freedom—because Jesus still lifts what’s crushing you.
